cues.text: On the edge of her bed, Yukari leans in close to the laptop's screen.

Yukari closes her eyes. Her Persona, Io, appears: a girl bound in chains, seated on a huge horned skull. In a burst of light it changes into Isis: a tall figure with a pale, mask-like face and curving horns, an orb held high above its head, and vast wings spread wide.
Back on the bed, Yukari sits with her eyes closed as a glowing sphere of light sinks into her chest.
